summary: Apple Hospitality REIT filed an 8-K to report Amendment No. 2 to its existing equity distribution agreement (ATM program), dated August 6, 2026. The amendment updates the list of agents, removing B. Riley Securities, SMBC Nikko, and Scotia Capital, and adding Huntington Securities. The company may sell up to $500 million of common shares through the agents. This is a routine capital markets facility update, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions are stated. Watch for future ATM sales but no risk-arb angle applies.
